disclosure: A2's early ledger status and some completed rows were visible before this rule was written. The review is exploratory, independent-from-author AI review, not a masked prospective human adjudication or confirmation of the full 800-call explanation population.

authored_products.frame: All 32 assigned final author turns (turn 2) across eight roots, two formats and two author models, including failed calls, invalid wrappers and unavailable host assessments.
authored_products.selection: Census: select every case with stage=author and turn=2 from the frozen A2 cases, ordered by case index. Do not filter on completion, syntax, fidelity, answer, cost or recipient outcome.
authored_products.review: Provide the evolving three-turn brief, actual linked prompts and outputs, final source or graph, all three state records, exact target claim and scope, and expected reference for source-to-task fidelity review. Record reviewers' evidence and reasons per root/state; never infer truth of a physical deployment from synthetic records.

explanations.frame: All 24 root×state blocks with eligible assigned fixed-direct, fixed-host-owned and authored-recipient cases. Native tool requests have no recipient-produced explanation and are outside this frame. Failed, missing and malformed results remain eligible and retain their assigned exposure.
explanations.block_order: Sort root IDs lexicographically; within each root order initial, adverse, restored.
explanations.exposure_allocation: For block index b from 0 to 23, omit exposure_order[b modulo 3], and include the other two. Exactly 48 slots: two per root×state and 16 per exposure. This decision depends on neither model responses nor accepted statuses.
explanations.within_exposure_selection: For each selected block and exposure, select the frozen eligible case that minimises SHA256 of the UTF-8 string '240924801|<case_id>'; break a theoretical hash tie with lexicographically smaller case_id. Stage/delivery determine exposure; do not inspect a result. Preserve the selected slot and mark missing if no response; never replace it with another completed case.
explanations.review: Supply the actual recipient messages and host packet, output verbatim, brief, claim, complete synthetic record and the pinned reference status/qualification. In addition supply the authored candidate and its source-fidelity review where relevant. Review status faithfulness, claim/scope identity, decisive evidence, objection/alternative handling, uncertainty and unsupported claims. A one-sentence omission may fail fidelity even when status matches.
explanations.blinding: Assign opaque sample IDs and retain a separate mapping to model, format and exposure. Redact model identity and explicit exposure names from the review view where possible, but the actual packet and native format can reveal treatment; report any such leakage. Do not call this a masked review.
explanations.outcomes: Record each reviewed explanation as faithful, unfaithful or unassessable with reason. Failed or absent outputs count as missing/unassessable in the fixed 48-slot frame. Report sampled denominators and exposure-specific counts; do not extrapolate to all 800 explanations as a confirmatory primary result.

reviewers: Two independent-from-author AI agents, separately reviewing the same fixed packet. Log agreement and discrepancies. This is not human review or measured human labour.
all_in_cost: Do not compute cost per correct qualified decision until all applicable authored candidates and explanations are independently adjudicated and author/reviewer time, acquisition/host compute, and billing have been reconciled. Provider-only cost per exact status can be described separately.
